title: Modified cellulose-based separator with high transference number and uniform lithium deposition for dendrite-free lithium metal batteries
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,45909-45915
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA07003A, Paper

Chao Gao, Lianghong Wu, Yulin Lu, Hang Sun, Yun Li, Weiwei Liu, Jinlan Luo, Changyong Song
This novel separator features acid-modified nanotubes that enlarge ion pathways, suppressing dendrites and enhancing electrolyte uptake. The resulting battery delivers exceptional rate capability and cycling stability.
